110300Z POSITION NEAR 28.7N 160.6E.

632 NM NORTH-NORTHWEST OF WAKE ISLAND, HAS TRACKED NORTH-
NORTHEASTWARD AT 10 KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS. THE LOW-LEVEL
CIRCULATION CENTER REMAINS FULLY EXPOSED IN ANIMATED MULTISPECTRAL
SATELLITE IMAGERY, WITH REMAINING CONVECTION HEAVILY SHEARED TO THE
EAST. A 102156Z SCATTEROMOTRY WIND SPEED IMAGE CONFIRMED THE
INITIAL INTENSITY OF 25 KNOTS. TD 15W HAS ENTERED A HOSTILE
ENVIRONMENT OF MODERATE-HIGH WIND SHEAR AND HAS BEEN UNABLE TO
SUPPORT CONVECTION NEAR THE LLCC. THE SYSTEM IS FORECAST TO
CONTINUE A DISSIPATION TREND, WITH INTENSITY DECREASING BELOW 20
KNOTS IN THE NEXT 12 HOURS AS IT TRANSITS GENERALLY NORTHWARD.
NUMERICAL MODEL GUIDANCE IS IN GOOD AGREEMENT ABOUT THE TERMINAL
WEAKENING OF TD 15W. THIS IS THE FINAL WARNING ON THIS SYSTEM BY
THE JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI. THE SYSTEM WILL BE
CLOSELY MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF REGENERATION.
MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE AT 110000Z IS 997MB.
MAXIMUM SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT 110000Z IS 11 FEET.
REFER TO TROPICAL STORM 13W (PEILOU) WARNINGS (WTPN32 PGTW)
FOR SIX-HOURLY UPDATES.

FOR SIX-HOURLY UPDATES.
